about.title: Achyuthan Asok
about.text1: I have spent the last 8+ years collaborating with agencies, artists, and studios to compress narratives into visually unforgettable moments. For me, video editing isn't just about putting two clips together; it's about engineering rhythm, sculpting atmosphere, and directing human emotion.
about.text2: Based in New York, working globally. Currently pushing boundaries with AI integrations, hybrid motion workflows, and advanced virtual production setups.

skills.name: Color Grading
skills.desc: Precise DaVinci Resolve color pipelines, customized LUT creation, film emulation, and scene matching to craft distinct moods.

skills.name: Visual Effects & Compositing
skills.desc: Screen replacement, clean plate generation, chroma keying, element integration, and particle system simulation in After Effects.

skills.name: Sound Design & Mixing
skills.desc: Immersive SFX layering, dialogue leveling, audio clean-up, beat synchronization, and atmospheric soundscaping.

skills.name: Cinematic Pacing & Rhythm
skills.desc: Mastery of editorial flow, emotional pacing, subverting narrative expectations, action matching, and precise dynamic cuts.
